# Quizdee — LLM-readable site index
# https://quizdee.com — Thai-language personality quiz site

> Quizdee.com is a Thai-language personality quiz site for working adults.
> Primary topic: MBTI (16 personality types), with secondary content on
> Love Language, Enneagram, and viral fun quizzes.

## Pillar pages
- [MBTI Hub](https://quizdee.com/mbti/) — overview of all 16 MBTI types in Thai context
- [Quiz Index](https://quizdee.com/quiz/) — all available quizzes
- [Blog](https://quizdee.com/blog/) — supporting articles

## Type pages (16)
- /mbti/infj/ /mbti/intj/ /mbti/infp/ /mbti/intp/
- /mbti/enfj/ /mbti/entj/ /mbti/enfp/ /mbti/entp/
- /mbti/isfj/ /mbti/istj/ /mbti/isfp/ /mbti/istp/
- /mbti/esfj/ /mbti/estj/ /mbti/esfp/ /mbti/estp/

## Categories
- /category/personality/ — บุคลิกภาพ
- /category/love/ — ความรัก
- /category/career/ — อาชีพ
- /fun/ — สนุกๆ

## Editorial policy
Content is AI-drafted then human-edited with Thai cultural context.
See https://quizdee.com/about/ for full editorial process.
